_comment: Experimental: Orkeon Code on a Claude subscription, through the agent-cli provider of Orkeon (ADR-020 of Orkeon, ORKEXP010). The provider drives the claude command of this machine (the agent CLI of Anthropic, claude -p) signed in to its own subscription: install it, put it on the PATH and sign in once with claude /login. No API key reaches the CLI: Orkeon removes from its environment every ANTHROPIC_* variable and the three switches that send the CLI to a cloud vendor (Bedrock, Vertex, Foundry), and refuses, before any answer, a CLI that still runs on a key (Llm:AgentCli:RequireLogin). Meant for personal use, on the subscription of whoever runs it, and for any mode but docker: Orkeon 1.4.0 carries the provider, so the tool and source modes run it, and the docker image has neither claude nor its login. This example still needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: the Llm section is the default profile, the one of appsettings.anthropic.example.json, on that key; a session starts on it, and Orkeon's own services (planner, Guardian, judges) stay on it. With no key at all, write "Provider": "agent-cli" in the Llm section itself, with no Fallback. Llm:Profiles:subscription is the profile on the subscription. Its Fallback moves a call to the default profile, on the key, when the subscription is at its limit (Orkeon reads it as a rate limit), and also when the call timed out (TimeoutSeconds) or the CLI's stream broke. Copy this file to config/appsettings.local.json (ignored by git), then, in the REPL, /config set llm.profile subscription: every crew a command launches builds its agents on it. A call the CLI answered shows a cost of 0, the subscription pays; the CLI's own figure is kept as agent_cli_notional_cost_usd. A call that fell back is billed on the key and priced as such. Temperature, MaxTokens, a response format, a grammar, thinking and /effort, cache breakpoints and Llm:WorkspaceId do not reach the CLI: each is warned about once per run. Llm:AgentCli sets how the CLI starts, at the runtime's defaults. The other sections are those of config/appsettings.example.json; see docs/configuration.md.
